sourceBoundParaphrase.en: Within this practitioner tradition, a missing name value 1 is called a Karmic Lesson and is used as a developmental reflection around initiative, autonomy, originality and self-direction. PHI OS does not treat absence as proof of deficiency; it keeps impatience, over-control or excessive self-reliance as a possible reflection boundary rather than a diagnosis.
sourceBoundParaphrase.zhHans: 在这一实践者传统中，姓名中缺少的数值 1 被称为 Karmic Lesson，可作为围绕主动、自主、原创与自我方向的发展性反思。PHI OS 不把缺失当作能力缺陷的证明，并把急躁、过度控制或过度依赖自己仅保留为可能的观察边界，而非诊断。
